mapper.sql:
select workflow_rows.*, case when workflow_status='DATA_INCONSISTENT' then 'DATA_INCONSISTENT' when workflow_status='EXCEPTION' then 'TRANSPORT_EXCEPTION' when workflow_status='WAITING_SHIPMENT' and order_create_time < date_sub(now(),interval 24 hour) then 'OVERDUE_UNSHIPPED' else null end attention_type, case when workflow_status='WAITING_SHIPMENT' and order_create_time < date_sub(now(),interval 24 hour) then 1 else 0 end overdue_unshipped from ( select base_rows.*, case when (shipment_id is null and order_status in ('SHIPPED','COMPLETED')) or (shipment_id is not null and order_status='PENDING_SHIPMENT') or (order_status='SHIPPED' and shipment_status='CANCELLED') or (order_status='COMPLETED' and shipment_status<>'DELIVERED') then 'DATA_INCONSISTENT' when order_status='COMPLETED' then 'COMPLETED' when order_status='PENDING_SHIPMENT' then 'WAITING_SHIPMENT' when shipment_status='DELIVERED' then 'DELIVERED_WAIT_RECEIPT' when operational_node_status='EXCEPTION' then 'EXCEPTION' when operational_node_status='OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' then 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' else 'IN_TRANSIT' end workflow_status from ( select o.order_id,o.order_no,o.status order_status,o.receiver_name,o.receiver_phone,o.create_time order_create_time, s.shipment_id,s.company_code,s.company_name,s.tracking_no,s.status shipment_status,s.shipped_time,s.delivered_time, latest.node_status latest_node_status,latest.title latest_node_title, latest.description latest_node_description,latest.location latest_node_location,latest.event_time latest_node_time, operational.node_status operational_node_status from mall_order o left join mall_logistics_shipment s on s.order_id=o.order_id left join mall_logistics_node latest on latest.node_id=( select n1.node_id from mall_logistics_node n1 where n1.shipment_id=s.shipment_id order by n1.event_time desc,n1.node_id desc limit 1) left join mall_logistics_node operational on operational.node_id=( select n2.node_id from mall_logistics_node n2 where n2.shipment_id=s.shipment_id and n2.node_status<>'CORRECTION' order by n2.event_time desc,n2.node_id desc limit 1) where o.status in ('PENDING_SHIPMENT','SHIPPED','COMPLETED') and o.order_no like concat('%',#{orderNo},'%')
and (o.receiver_name like concat('%',#{receiverKeyword},'%') or o.receiver_phone like concat('%',#{receiverKeyword},'%'))
and s.company_code=#{companyCode} and o.create_time>=#{createStart} and o.create_time<=#{createEnd} ) base_rows ) workflow_rows
mapper.select:
select fulfillment.* from () fulfillment
order by case when attention_type is null then 1 else 0 end,order_create_time desc,order_id desc

select count(*) total_count, coalesce(sum(workflow_status='WAITING_SHIPMENT'),0) waiting_shipment_count, coalesce(sum(workflow_status='IN_TRANSIT'),0) in_transit_count, coalesce(sum(workflow_status='OUT_FOR_DELIVERY'),0) out_for_delivery_count, coalesce(sum(workflow_status='EXCEPTION'),0) exception_count, coalesce(sum(workflow_status='DELIVERED_WAIT_RECEIPT'),0) delivered_wait_receipt_count, coalesce(sum(workflow_status='COMPLETED'),0) completed_count, coalesce(sum(attention_type='OVERDUE_UNSHIPPED'),0) overdue_unshipped_count, coalesce(sum(workflow_status='DATA_INCONSISTENT'),0) data_inconsistent_count from () fulfillment
